name: supportflow-mern
description: SupportFlow — AI-assisted customer support desk built on the MERN stack (MongoDB Atlas, Express.js, React, Node.js) with Gemini AI triage, realtime Socket.IO and JWT auth.

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
